lines.quote: build your own platform, even if you have to be crazy to get attention — otherwise someone else controls your story and you're the villain

lines.quote: I think he was intentionally painted the villain by the filmmaker

why did Carlos Watson… get a get-out-of-jail-free pass? And Elizabeth Holmes is still sitting her ass in jail

lines.quote: sophisticated investors like Rupert Murdoch… he absolutely knew
